Press Releases | Jul 14, 2026

### BYK portfolio extended by a more environmentally friendly, alkali-resistant wetting and
### dispersing additive for aqueous systems

Wesel, July 14, 2026 – With DISPERBYK-2180, BYK has introduced a new wetting and dispersing additive
for inorganic pigments and fillers in aqueous systems. The polycarboxylate-ether-based additive is
designed for applications requiring a high degree of stability across a wide pH range.

more

][155]
[
[Group photo of the winning BYK team]
News | Jul 3, 2026

### BYK team wins the ALTANA Innovation Award

We are delighted! Our BYK team has won this year’s ALTANA Innovation Award for the successful and
sustainable development of PFAS-free defoamers and the corresponding transition of the defoamer
portfolio to PFAS-free solutions. Led by BYK CTO Dr. Michael Schmidt (on the right in the photo) and
ALTANA AG CTO Dr. Petra Severit (third from the left), the team includes Sven Tenbusch, Dr.
Alexander Gers-Barlag, Volker Thyssen-Wallner, and Annika Winkelhausen. They have developed a new
generation of sustainable defoamers that contain no forever chemicals and are essential for
producing paints and coatings. BYK has been producing entirely PFAS-free products since 2025, making
it a pioneer in the industry. The award was presented at the ALTANA Innovation Conference (AICON) in
Wesel.

Customers We Serve

## Superior Multi-Industry Color Management Solutions

Our world is full of vibrant colors, and the accuracy of these colors is invaluable to many
industries. Since 1970, Datacolor’s color management tools ([like spectrophotometers][35]) and
software have helped color experts around the world get color right.

Here is a sample of industries we serve.

[

### Textile and Apparel

Enabling all partners in a textile supply chain to expedite color development, deliver optimum color
quality, and add significant value to the complex color management process.

][36]
[

### Paint and Coatings

Increase efficiency, reduce waste and speed up production with our suite of color measurement,
formulation and quality control solutions.

][37]
[

### Plastics

From resins to pellets to finished products, you can ensure color accuracy across a wide range of
materials: opaque or translucent, smooth or textured, glossy or flat.

][38]
[
[Car Interior]

### Automotive Interiors

Materials used in car interiors are wide ranging and achieving color harmony between thousands of
suppliers requires strong color management.

][39]
[
[Friendly Retail Paint Rep]

# Home English

Color Measurement Spectrophotometer Supplier & Manufacturer

# Color Measurement Spectrophotometer Supplier & Manufacturer

Why is color measurement so important? Look around. The world is color. For companies, color
consistency is a key indicator of quality, safety and brand integrity. Getting it right means
everything. And as industry pioneers, we know this better than anyone.

## Color Measurement Spectrophotometer Supplier & Manufacturer

As a leading color measurement spectrophotometer supplier and manufacturer, we know better than
anyone the importance of color as a key indicator of quality, safety and brand integrity. You can
count on our high-quality lab colorimeters and spectrophotometers to provide consistent color
measurement results.

TRUSTED BY THE BEST ALL OVER THE WORLD
* [Kraft Heinz logo in blue and red]
* [Dupont logo in bright red]
* [Pfizer logo with both dark and light blue colors]
* [Mars Wrigley in a deep blue color]
* [Tesla logo in bright red]
* [Mondelez International logo in black]
* [Bristol Myers Squibb company logo with a purple hand on the left side]
* [Johnson & Johnson logo in deep red]
* [Frito Lay logo in red, white, and yellow]
* [3M logo in bright red]
[Schedule Demo][1]

## Watch Now

**HARNESSING THE POWER OF COLOR SCIENCE**

[ [Watch Now] Watch video ][2]

## Our Products

Solids, liquids, powders and more — our color spectrophotometers can measure it all.

[

### Benchtop Spectrophotometers

Directional (45°/0° and 0°/45°) geometry benchtop spectrophotometers replicate the human visual
response to color and include applications where gloss and texture can affect the color measurement.

[CFL2-ProductTile.webp] Learn More
][3] [

### Portable Spectrophotometers

From shipping departments to storage areas to plant production floors, our portable
spectrophotometers allow you to measure on the go for the ultimate testing convenience. Choose from
Directional 45°/0° and Diffuse d/8° geometries.

[MiniScan EZ-ProductTile.webp] Learn More
][4] [

### In-Process / In-Line Spectrophotometer

When installed in a process stream, in-process (in-line) spectrophotometers provide continuous color
measurement data throughout a production run, enabling quick responses to color variations.

[SpectraTrendHT-ProductTile.webp] Learn More
][5] [

### Quality Control (QC) Software

Color matching software that reports absolute and color-difference data in all widely used color
scales under various lighting and observing conditions.

[Software-Tile.webp] Learn More
][6] [

### Check Out All of Our Products

[All-Products-Tile.webp] Learn More

## Exact-Fit™ RF Instruments

We design instruments that allow engineers to capture, understand, and reproduce the full complexity
of real-world RF spectra...

...without the time, risk, and frustration of turning a barebones instrument into what you actually
need.  

#### Tailored for your specific measurement challenges

For decades, the RF instrumentation market has given you only two options. You could choose a
traditional rack-and-stack instrument, with a static feature set, that will never evolve with you
over time. Or you could choose a pile of parts, throw in a programming language, and try to build
your own instrument in your spare time.

**We think it’s time for a third option. That’s why we invented Exact-Fit™ RF instruments.**

An exact-fit RF instrument is precisely tailored for the measurement you need to make. Maybe you
need to measure 4 RF signals at once, pull a tiny signal out of a forest of interference and
jamming, or make a permanent record of RF signals on a test range. These are perfect challenges for
an exact-fit RF instrument. It’s what you use when a standard spectrum analyzer or signal generator
can’t get the job done.

#### Base Instruments

An exact-fit RF instrument starts with a proven base design as the foundation. That’s a key reason
it’s called an exact-fit, and not a full custom. Starting with a base design allows us to show you
basic operational concepts early, minimize engineering risk, and get you up and running as quickly
as possible. Spectra Lab has three base platforms that serve as a starting point for every exact-fit
instrument:

[Placeholder Image]

Spectrum Defender™

Duplicate real-world RF environments in the lab. Make RF recordings that never miss a single pulse.
Instantly replay RF signals in the field or lab. You’ll be up and running in 15 minutes with this
easy-to-use RF record and playback instrument.
[
RF Signal Recorder
][10]
[Placeholder Image]

Signal Trove™

Stream and save every byte of signal data from your PXIe instrumentation. Signal Trove is SSD
storage specifically designed for sustaining the high data rates you’ll encounter in wideband test
and measurement applications.
[
Coming Soon
][11]
[Placeholder Image]

Antenna Wrangler™

Reject over-the-air interference to maximize received signal quality. Antenna Wrangler’s LNA,
pre-selection, and antenna interface is the perfect front-end for an RF recorder, spectrum analyzer,
or any other RF receiver.
[
Coming Soon
][12]

## Exact-Fit™ RF Instruments

We design instruments that allow engineers to capture, understand, and reproduce the full complexity
of real-world RF spectra...

...without the time, risk, and frustration of turning a barebones instrument into what you actually
need.  

#### Tailored for your specific measurement challenges

For decades, the RF instrumentation market has given you only two options. You could choose a
traditional rack-and-stack instrument, with a static feature set, that will never evolve with you
over time. Or you could choose a pile of parts, throw in a programming language, and try to build
your own instrument in your spare time.

**We think it’s time for a third option. That’s why we invented Exact-Fit™ RF instruments.**

An exact-fit RF instrument is precisely tailored for the measurement you need to make. Maybe you
need to measure 4 RF signals at once, pull a tiny signal out of a forest of interference and
jamming, or make a permanent record of RF signals on a test range. These are perfect challenges for
an exact-fit RF instrument. It’s what you use when a standard spectrum analyzer or signal generator
can’t get the job done.

#### Base Instruments

An exact-fit RF instrument starts with a proven base design as the foundation. That’s a key reason
it’s called an exact-fit, and not a full custom. Starting with a base design allows us to show you
basic operational concepts early, minimize engineering risk, and get you up and running as quickly
as possible. Spectra Lab has three base platforms that serve as a starting point for every exact-fit

Since 2006 Admesy has developed to a well-known brand, offering a wide range of user-friendly and

### Applications
* Display characterization
* Automotive
* Flicker
* Spectroscopy
* Lighting

Display characterization is the process of accurately measuring and describing the color and
luminance properties of display devices such as monitors, projectors, and televisions. This process
is crucial for achieving consistent and precise color reproduction accross different devices and
viewing environments.

Key aspects of display characterization are color gamut, gamma response, white point, brightness and
contrast, and uniformity.

[ Display ][79]

In the automotive industriy, display characterization is essential for ensuring that various screens
in a vehicle provide accurate, consistent, and reliable visual information to the driver and
passengers. With the increasing prevalence of digital displays in modern vehicles, from infotainment
systems to digital instrument clusters, heads-up displays (HUDs) and also human machine interfaces
(HMI) is crucial for safety, usability, and aesthetic appeal.

Display characterization in the automotive industry is vital for ensuring that vehicle displays are
safe, reliable, and provide an optimal user experience. By employing advanced measurement tools and
techniques, high standards of performance and consistency, ultimately enhancing the overall quality
and safety can be achieved.

Some of the key aspects of automotive display characterization are Brightness and contrast, color
accuracy, viewing angles and response time.

[ Color measurement and white point adjustment for automotive R&D ][80]

Flicker measurment refers to the evaluation of fluctuations in the brightness. These fluctuations
can be perceived by the human eye as flicker and can cause discomfort, headaches, or other adverse
health effects.

[ Flicker ][81]

Spectroscopy is the scientific study and analysis of the interaction between matter and
electromagnetic radiation. It involves measuring how different substances absorb, emit, or scatter
light across a range of wavelenghts. By examining theses interactions, spectroscopy provides
valuable insights into the comosition, structure, and properties of substances.

different aspects of light.

accurate and vibrant color reproduction on every textile surface.

Our state-of-the-art color spectrophotometers promise to redefine your package and label printing

are designed to help you hit the perfect note, offering vibrant, consistent, and accurate color

Your trusted source for product sales, service, and support for leading manufacturers for more than
30 years.

## Precision Products. Proven Support.


CMG Sales is committed to helping manufacturers achieve higher quality, greater efficiency, and
improved performance. We offer a wide selection of precision measurement instruments, sensors, and
data acquisition software, each designed to enhance your manufacturing process while reducing costs.

Beyond our products, we provide the highest level of support, including application guidance,
training, and repair services. Our team works closely with every customer to ensure you have the
right tools and knowledge to meet your production goals.

We also offer ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration services for coating thickness gauges, XRF
fluorescence instruments, NIST traceable calibration of particle size analyzers, and coating
thickness standards.

With nearly 30 years of experience serving area manufacturers, CMG Sales understands what matters
most to our customers: quality products, competitive pricing, and trusted relationships built on
service and expertise.

## FAQ

### How does AI color analysis work?

AI analyzes your photo to detect your skin undertones, hair and eye colors. Based on the **12-season
color analysis** system, it finds your personal color palette for clothes, makeup, and hair color.

### How accurate is Dressika AI analysis?

Dressika color analysis is trained on thousands of professional draping results and detects your
skin tone, undertone, and contrast with high precision.

### What do I get with my color analysis?

You get your color type, 120 clothing colors, 170 makeup shades, and 180 hair colors — all instantly
available in your profile.

### Do I need special lighting or equipment?

No special equipment needed — just take a selfie in daylight facing window without direct sunlight
on your face and heavy makeup. Dressika will do the rest!

### Why am I getting different results sometimes?

It’s completely normal! Your features may fall between two seasonal palettes, meaning you share
traits from both. For the most consistent outcome, try a few photos and choose the one that feels
most like your natural self. Our color consultants can also help you confirm your perfect match.

### Can I use Dressika for shopping?

Yes! Use Dressika’s virtual wardrobe and color matching to check if your new clothes fit your
palette before you buy. You can also shop in your favourite online stores directly from the app.

### Can I try different hair colors or makeup?

Absolutely. Dressika lets you preview hair and makeup shades that perfectly match your season and
skin tone — right on your photo.

## FAQ

### How does AI color analysis work?

AI analyzes your photo to detect your skin undertones, hair and eye colors. Based on the **12-season
color analysis** system, it finds your personal color palette for clothes, makeup, and hair color.

### How accurate is Dressika AI analysis?

Dressika color analysis is trained on thousands of professional draping results and detects your
skin tone, undertone, and contrast with high precision.

### What do I get with my color analysis?

You get your color type, 120 clothing colors, 170 makeup shades, and 180 hair colors — all instantly
available in your profile.

### Do I need special lighting or equipment?

No special equipment needed — just take a selfie in daylight facing window without direct sunlight
on your face and heavy makeup. Dressika will do the rest!

### Why am I getting different results sometimes?

It’s completely normal! Your features may fall between two seasonal palettes, meaning you share
traits from both. For the most consistent outcome, try a few photos and choose the one that feels
most like your natural self. Our color consultants can also help you confirm your perfect match.

### Can I use Dressika for shopping?

Yes! Use Dressika’s virtual wardrobe and color matching to check if your new clothes fit your
palette before you buy. You can also shop in your favourite online stores directly from the app.

### Can I try different hair colors or makeup?

Absolutely. Dressika lets you preview hair and makeup shades that perfectly match your season and
skin tone — right on your photo.

positive features.

all!


[Find Your Colors][11]

look absolutely remarkable!

Follow these 3 steps and let the power of color work for you! Get started and take your color
analysis test now!

ColorHexa.com is a free color tool providing information about any color and generating matching
color palettes for your designs (such as complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic or
monochromatic colors schemes).

Just type any [color value][8] in the search field and ColorHexa will offer a detailed description
and automatically convert it to its equivalent in Hexadecimal, RGB, CMYK, HSL, HSV, CIE-LAB / LUV /
LCH, Hunter-Lab, XYZ, xyY and Binary.

**Convert, generate palettes, and get any color information**
* RGB 187, 0, 0
* CMYK 0, 100, 100, 27
* HSL 0°, 100, 36.7

Enter any Hex, RGB or HSL [values][9].

`#ff0000`

**Blend, subtract or create a gradient between two colors**

Separate your query with +, - or to.

`hsl(279,13,20) to red 255 blue 0 green 60`

# Color encyclopedia : Information and conversion.

* [Examples][2]
* [Gradient generator][3]
* [Color blender][4]
* [Color subtraction][5]
* [216 web safe colors][6]
* [Colors by name][7]

ColorHexa.com is a free color tool providing information about any color and generating matching
color palettes for your designs (such as complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic or
monochromatic colors schemes).

Just type any [color value][8] in the search field and ColorHexa will offer a detailed description
and automatically convert it to its equivalent in Hexadecimal, RGB, CMYK, HSL, HSV, CIE-LAB / LUV /
LCH, Hunter-Lab, XYZ, xyY and Binary.

**Convert, generate palettes, and get any color information**
* RGB 187, 0, 0
* CMYK 0, 100, 100, 27
* HSL 0°, 100, 36.7

Enter any Hex, RGB or HSL [values][9].

`#ff0000`

**Blend, subtract or create a gradient between two colors**

Separate your query with +, - or to.

`hsl(279,13,20) to red 255 blue 0 green 60`

## Trending Colors

][8]

## Pick and work with colours without the fuss

We built Color Picker in 2025 because we were tired of heavyweight apps and complicated colour
pickers. As front‑end developers and illustrators ourselves, we needed something that let us grab a
colour, tweak it and move on. What started as an internal tool quickly became popular with
colleagues, so we tidied it up and put it on the web for anyone to use. No accounts, no learning
curve – just load the page, choose a shade and copy the HEX, RGB, HSL or HSV codes.

### Why do people like our color picker?

If you’ve ever stared at a design and wondered how to capture just the right hue, you’ll appreciate
how simple Color Picker feels. We kept the interface minimal on purpose:
* **You click, you get your color** – tap anywhere on the palette and the tool spits out the exact
  values you need. Want to sample a photo, screenshot or piece of artwork? Drag it into the page and
  use the eyedropper to grab a pixel.
* **Gradients made easy** – you can build silky smooth transitions by adding and moving stops on a
  bar. Switch between linear and radial gradients, adjust angles and transparency, then copy the CSS
  when you’re happy.
* **No limits, no cost** – Color Picker runs in any modern browser on desktop, tablet or phone.
  There’s nothing to install and no charge to use it.
* **Extensions when you need them** – our optional Chrome and Edge add‑ons bring the eyedropper
  right into your browser, so you can sample colours from any page and keep your history with you.

### What you’ll find inside

#### Eyedropper

Pull colours directly from uploaded images or anything on your screen; drop a file into the page and
click a pixel to see its values in multiple formats.

#### Format conversions

Instantly switch between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV and copy the codes into CSS, design software, or
palette tools.

#### Gradient maker

Create linear or radial gradients by adding and sliding stops, adjusting angle and transparency and
grabbing the finished CSS.

#### Color history

Every colour you pick sticks around, so you can come back to it later or reuse it across projects.

#### Browser add‑ons

Optional Chrome and Edge extensions let you sample colours from any site and open the tool right
from your toolbar.

#### Universal access

Works in any modern browser; extensions support multiple languages and receive regular updates.

#### Free & private

The service is free and we don’t trade in your data.

## What it’s good for

Different people use Color Picker in different ways:
* **Designers and product teams** reach for it when they’re sketching out interfaces or brand
  palettes. It’s quick to explore combinations and grab the CSS you need for gradients.
* **Illustrators and artists** use the eyedropper to pull inspiration from photos and paintings. The
  gradient tool helps plan smooth shading and colour transitions.
* **Front‑end developers** lean on it to generate consistent colour values across projects. The
  extension makes sampling colours from existing sites effortless.
* **Anyone checking accessibility** can view colours in different models and tweak opacity until
  they meet contrast guidelines.

## Getting started

You don’t need a manual to use our picker, but here’s a quick rundown:
* **Choose your colour** – click anywhere on the palette. You’ll immediately see the HEX, RGB, and
  HSV values. Use the sliders to nudge hue, saturation, brightness, and transparency.
* **Sample from an image** – drop an image file onto the page or select one. Click the pixel you
  want, and the colour codes appear.
* **Build a gradient** – click on the gradient bar to add stops and drag them around; toggle between
  linear and radial styles. Fine‑tune the angle and opacity until you like the result.
* **Copy and reuse** – your colours and gradients are automatically saved. Copy the codes or CSS and
  paste them into your project or share them with your team.

## Here is how to use Color Picker online

[CSS Gradient Generator]

## Extensions for Chrome and Edge

Love the idea of plucking colours right off a webpage? Our Colour Picker – Eye Dropper for Chrome
and Eyedropper – Color Picker for Edge let you do just that. They add a small button to your browser
so you can hover over any element and capture its shade. You can still upload images through the
pop‑up, combine colours into gradients and copy the CSS. The extensions support multiple languages
and are updated regularly.

# Color Game

Coloruno is a free browser color memory game with no signup, built around five colors recreated from
memory. If you are looking for a viral color memory game that tests how well you remember color as
it actually feels, not as a hex code on a screen, Coloruno gives you a fast way to find out. We show
you five colors, hide them, and ask you to recreate each shade from memory with simple color
controls.

Every round is scored out of 10 points, and a complete board is scored out of 50. The closer your
recreated color is to the original, the higher your score. The core loop is simple: memorize,
recreate, compare, and try again.

The normal Coloruno game needs JavaScript because the color picker, timers, score animations,
multiplayer rooms, and leaderboards are interactive. If you are reading this no-JavaScript version,
you can still learn what the game is, how the scoring works, and how privacy is handled. Enable
JavaScript in a modern browser to play instantly with no signup and no download.

## Daily Color Game

The daily Coloruno challenge gives everyone the same five colors for the day. You get one board, one
memory test, and one clean score to compare with other players. Daily mode is built for quick play:
memorize the color, recreate it, see the round score, and move through the full set of five. It is a
small daily puzzle for your visual memory, color recall, and attention to subtle shifts in hue,
saturation, and brightness.

Solo mode lets you practice the same core color memory loop whenever you want. Easy mode gives you a
little more time to study each color, while hard mode makes the reveal shorter. Streak mode keeps
going while your scores stay strong. Solo, friend challenge, daily global challenge: Coloruno
supports the quick practice run, the shareable multiplayer link, and the same daily board for every
player. Random modes add extra twists, including gradients, blind sliders, imposter colors, memory
stacks, and Toon Match character color challenges.

## Multiplayer Color Game

Multiplayer Coloruno creates a shared challenge link so friends can play the same five colors and
compare who remembered them more accurately. The goal is always clear: hold the target color in your
head, rebuild it from memory, and find out how close your eye really got.

Coloruno scores color accuracy with a perceptual model, so the result is based on how different two
colors look to people, not just how far apart their slider values are. A tiny shift in a pale yellow
should not feel the same as a huge jump across the color wheel. The scoring page explains the model,
the total score, and why a board near 50 means your color memory was unusually sharp.

Also known as a color game, colour game, color memory game, colour memory game, color matching game,
color recall test, color quiz, colour quiz, color perception game, visual memory game, and daily
browser puzzle. Related search terms like color recall/color quiz fit because Coloruno is about
testing the color you held in memory, not typing an answer. Coloruno is built for fast play on
desktop and mobile browsers, with daily boards, solo practice, multiplayer links, random challenges,
local stats, and leaderboards.

## Cartoon Color Game

Toon Match is Coloruno's cartoon color game. It turns character-inspired colors into a five-round
color matching challenge where you recreate the shade from memory and compare your score out of 50.

## Flag Color Game

Flag Match is Coloruno's flag color game. It uses country flag color prompts and asks you to tune
hue, saturation, and brightness until your recreated flag color is as close as possible to the real
target.

## Logo Color Game

Logo Match is Coloruno's logo color game. It uses famous logo mark prompts and asks you to tune hue,
saturation, and brightness until your recreated logo color is as close as possible to the real
target.

### FAQ

##### How does Color Analysis help me?

Ever hear that a color was "so perfect for you"? Eliminate the mystery and the painful process of
trial and error and score guaranteed gorgeousness with a custom palette. Dress with the confidence
that every color you flaunt is a winner. Whether used for makeup, fashion or something else,
showcasing your just-right shades is the best way to highlight natural beauty. After completing your
palette, you can add it to a Pinterest board or have it at the ready with our digital palette app.
[[Wardling App - Personal AI Stylist]][12]

##### Is there help for body shape and styling too?

Colorwise helps you discover your best colors. If you want to know what to actually wear, our mobile
app [Wardling][13] takes the next step. Upload a photo and get outfit ideas shaped around your body
proportions, personal style, and styling goals, not just your palette. It can restyle a look, refine
specific pieces, and help you explore options that feel more flattering, intentional, and wearable.
[[Wardling App - Personal AI Stylist]][14]

##### Is AI analysis accurate?

Colorwise pioneered AI-powered color analysis and uses a state-of-the-art model that we continually
improve. To make the most of colorwise.me, ensure you select a clear, high-resolution headshot
snapped in good lighting. Select only the most prominent tones for your skin, hair, and eyes,
otherwise results might be skewed. If your natural coloring is between two or more seasonal types,
colorwise.me will switch from the [12 Seasons][15] System to the broader and classic [4 Season][16]
types.

##### Why am I getting inconsistent results?

Getting inconsistent results usually means that your coloring is in-between two or more color types.
If you repeat the analysis several times, you'll notice before long that one palette is returned
more often than any others. That'll be your best palette. Still unsure? Verify with our

# Color Memory Game Online

Three seconds to lock the target. Then the reference is gone.

Color Memory // Direct Play

## Memorize fast. Rebuild clean.

Three seconds to lock the target. Then the reference is gone. Start the drill and see whether your
recall holds.

EasyHardBrutal
Start Color Run
Play Daily SeedCreate Challenge

5 colors · 3s reveal · perceptual scoring

Tap to arm the chamber.

Sponsored

How It Works

## Show the color. Remove the reference. Trust your recall.

Dialed Games starts with a simple drill: show a color, hide it, then ask you to rebuild it from
memory. That is what makes this a color memory game rather than a basic picker. The tension comes
from the gap between what felt obvious during the reveal and what stays stable once the color is
gone.

Why Scoring Feels Fair

## Close-looking matches should score like close-looking matches.

The score is based on perceptual color distance rather than raw slider math, so it rewards what
actually looks close to the eye. If you want the full logic behind CIEDE2000 and the rest of the
pipeline, the [scoring page][7] breaks it down in plain English.

Memory Pressure

## Guessing from memory is different from matching with a live reference.

This is still a color guessing game and a color matching game, but the guess is informed by recall
rather than by direct visual comparison. You are not chasing the right answer on screen. You are
testing whether the original hue, saturation, and brightness survived in short-term memory once the
display went blank.

Games Like Dialed.gg

## A wider perception loop, built for short browser sessions.

Some players arrive here looking for games like Dialed.gg. That intent makes sense. These drills are
built around perception, memory drift, and short bursts of pressure. Dialed Games is an independent
collection and is not affiliated with the official Dialed.gg website, but if you want the wider
context you can read [games like Dialed.gg][12] or [what Dialed.gg is][13].

## Color Memory Game FAQ

### What is a color memory game?

A color memory game asks you to memorize a target color and recreate it from memory as accurately as
possible.

### Is Dialed Games free?

Yes. Dialed Games is free to play in your browser, with no account wall before you start.

### Is this the official Dialed.gg website?

No. Dialed Games is an independent game collection and is not affiliated with the official Dialed.gg
website.

### What other challenges can I play?

You can also play a sound memory game and a rhythm challenge game that test pitch recall and timing
accuracy.

**Digital Promoters (India) Pvt. Ltd.** began operations in 1979 in the Digital Measurement
Instruments** and Control** sector. It has since risen from humble beginnings to become North
India's leading **Test, Measurement, Control and Calibration hub**. Instrumentation remains our core
business and we are committed to meet our Customers' every need. With our commitment to constantly
carry out the required measure for Quality Control, we acquired the **ISO 9001:2000 **certification
in 2003 and have since been upgrading it to the latest **ISO 9001:2008** Quality Control Standards.

**VISION
**
Our vision is to be an Industry leader, providing one stop **Digital Measurement Instruments** like
Inductive proximity switches, proximity switches, capacitive proximity switches and Control
solutions. We aim to deliver to our customers a wide variety of good quality Test, Measurement &
Control equipment backed by efficient service support, professional approach and customer friendly
attitude. We are committed to excel in all areas of our business: be it sales, calibration or
support services thus delighting our valued customers. We shall bring continual improvement in all
our processes and systems.

**BUSINESS**

We offer the latest microprocessor based instruments of high quality, high reliability and state of
the art technology to our customers in India and Abroad. Our customers are from varied fields and
include the following industries:
* Pharmaceutical Industry
* Food Industry
* Automobile Industry
* Chemical Industry
* Sugar Industry
* Oil Industry
* Cement Industry
* Plastic Industry
* Electrical Industry
* Other Process Industry.

## Color & Appearance Measurement Applications**

Representing some world leading brands and the exclusive distributor or reseller in Malaysia. Our
product principals are **Konica Minolta Sensing Singapore, GTI Graphic Technology Inc. U.S.A.,
Rhopoint Instrument U.K., Instrument Systems GmBH Germany,** **Radiant Vision Systems U.S.A.** and
**SPECIM Finland**** **The products that we focus on include colorimeter, color spectrophotometer,
gloss meter, imaging photometer, imaging colorimeter. spectrometer, spectroradiometer, standard
lighting color viewing systems, light measurement devices, hyperspectral imaging cameras and etc.

## NEWS AND EVENT

**CA-527 Color Analyzer**


Konica Minolta CA-527 is a next-generation display color analyzer designed for the evaluation of
cutting-edge display technologies, such as OLED and micro-LED displays.. [**More**][82]

**All New Spectrophotometer CM-17d**

**[Spectrophotometer CM-17d]**

DS Technology & Services Sdn Bhd is excited to introduce the all new advanced Konica Minolta
vertical handheld spectrophotometer model CM-17d. It is ideal for use in quality control,
production, product development applications etc. [**Mor****e**][83]

**CS-3000Spectroradiometer**

The Konica Minolta CS-3000 series spectroradiometers are a new generation of high-performance
instruments for measuring the spectral characteristics of light sources. They offer a number of
features that make them ideal for a wide range of applications in quality control, color matching,
and product development applications. [**More**][84]

**SPECTRAMAGIC NX 2 SOFTWARE**

SpectraMagic NX 2 is a color data software developed by Konica Minolta that allows users to manage
and control colors with ease. It is designed to store measurement data and provide detailed color
analysis of samples when used in conjunction with Konica Minolta Sensing spectrophotometers or
colorimeters. [**More**][85]

## DS TECHNOLOGY & SERVICES SDN BHD

Incorporated in 31st March 2009 as a technology company in Malaysia. Offering wide and full range of
radiometry, photometry, color, appearance (gloss measurement), light and display measurement
instruments and equipment. Representing Konica Minolta Sensing products, GTI Graphic Technology
Inc., Rhopoint Instruments UK, Instrument Systems GmBH, Radiant Vision Systems U.S.A, Hyperspectral
Imaging Ltd Finland

Other services include repair & re-calibration service of Konica Minolta Sensing products, Pre and
Post Sales support.

## NEWS AND EVENT

**CA-527 Color Analyzer**


Konica Minolta CA-527 is a next-generation display color analyzer designed for the evaluation of
cutting-edge display technologies, such as OLED and micro-LED displays.. [**More**][82]

**All New Spectrophotometer CM-17d**

**[Spectrophotometer CM-17d]**

DS Technology & Services Sdn Bhd is excited to introduce the all new advanced Konica Minolta
vertical handheld spectrophotometer model CM-17d. It is ideal for use in quality control,
production, product development applications etc. [**Mor****e**][83]

**CS-3000Spectroradiometer**

The Konica Minolta CS-3000 series spectroradiometers are a new generation of high-performance
instruments for measuring the spectral characteristics of light sources. They offer a number of
features that make them ideal for a wide range of applications in quality control, color matching,
and product development applications. [**More**][84]

**SPECTRAMAGIC NX 2 SOFTWARE**

SpectraMagic NX 2 is a color data software developed by Konica Minolta that allows users to manage
and control colors with ease. It is designed to store measurement data and provide detailed color
analysis of samples when used in conjunction with Konica Minolta Sensing spectrophotometers or
colorimeters. [**More**][85]

Incorporated in 31st March 2009 as a technology company in Malaysia. Offering wide and full range of
radiometry, photometry, color, appearance (gloss measurement), light and display measurement
instruments and equipment. Representing Konica Minolta Sensing products, GTI Graphic Technology
Inc., Rhopoint Instruments UK, Instrument Systems GmBH, Radiant Vision Systems U.S.A, Hyperspectral
Imaging Ltd Finland

Other services include repair & re-calibration service of Konica Minolta Sensing products, Pre and
Post Sales support.

ES Canada is a wholly owned subsidiary of the [MIRIADE Group][42], alongside ES France and EMCO
Elektronik. Through ES France (es-france.com)—a leading French value-added distributor founded in
1963—our Group has built long-standing expertise in instrumentation, components, and advanced test &
measurement solutions for demanding industrial and scientific environments. Backed by a stable,
family-owned shareholder base and a strong technical culture, ES France serves 5,000 customers with
a team of 110 employees, delivering both local proximity and international reach.

Our Canadian arm, ES Canada, is devoted to three distinct categories of products:
* Environmental Test and Measurement Solutions
* Innovative Agritech products
* Laboratories and Industrial Applications

We take great care in choosing our partners, prioritizing the quality of their products, accuracy in
measurements, reliable calibration processes, and a commitment to innovation.

**Nous sommes heureux de vous offrir tous nos services en Français et en Anglais.**

## How to use Flag Tone

One Classic game is 5 rounds. Each round picks a distinct random flag and target band—no repeats in
the same game; match its true color with the sliders while the flag preview updates—no hex cheats.
1. 1**Study the flag** — the left panel shows which band to match; other regions stay at their true
   colors.
2. 2**Adjust H, S, and B** — the right preview updates live. Hue is color angle, saturation is
   intensity, brightness is how bright the color feels.
3. 3**Submit your guess** — you'll see how far off you were and your points for that round.
4. 4**Play all 5 rounds** — then review every target next to your pick on the results screen.
5. 5**Start over anytime** — use New game or Play again for a fresh set of distinct random flags and
   bands.

## Flag Tone FAQ

### In Flag Tone, what is ΔE (delta E), in simple terms?

In Flag Tone, after you submit, **ΔE is one number that says how different your color is from the
target**—like a distance score. **Lower is better**: small ΔE means the two colors are very similar;
big ΔE means they're far apart. You don't need Flag Tone's scale memorized—just know Flag Tone uses
it to measure "how far off" you were.

Technical note: Flag Tone converts both colors into a standard color space (CIELAB) that lines up
better with human vision than raw screen pixels, then takes the straight-line distance between them.
In Flag Tone, that distance is what we call ΔE here.

### In Flag Tone, what are pts (points)?

In Flag Tone, **pts are your Flag Tone game score in plain numbers.** Each turn in Flag Tone, you
can earn up to **100 pts** depending on how close you got. The Flag Tone number at the top is your
**running total** across turns you've already finished. When Flag Tone's all 5 turns are done, the
best possible total is **500 pts** (100 × 5).

### In Flag Tone, how is one turn's score (pts) calculated?

In Flag Tone, when you press **Submit guess**, Flag Tone compares your color to the target, gets one
ΔE for that turn, then turns ΔE into pts using this Flag Tone rule:

pts for this turn = round( max(0, 100 − 2 × ΔE) )

In words for Flag Tone: **the farther off you are (bigger ΔE), the fewer pts**; a near-perfect Flag
Tone match (ΔE near 0) is close to **100 pts**. Flag Tone scores cannot go below **0**.

Flag Tone examples: ΔE ≈ 0 → about **100 pts**; ΔE = **10** → **80 pts**; ΔE = **25** → **50 pts**.

### Why does Flag Tone use sliders (HSB) instead of typing a hex code?

Flag Tone wants you to **look** at color and nudge it like you would in a design app—warmer, cooler,
stronger, softer, darker, lighter. Hex codes stay in the background so the challenge stays visual.

### What happens if you stare at the flag long enough?

Nothing—unless you mean **press** long enough. During a round, hold your pointer on the flag preview
for **five full seconds** without letting up. The true colors appear; release and Flag Tone hides
them again. We keep that one out of the main board on purpose—spoilers travel faster down here in
the FAQ.

### Are Flag Tone's flag colors official government specifications?

**No.** In Flag Tone, flag geometry and colors are **reference illustrations for the game**—not
certified official specs, Pantone drop-ins, or manufacturing standards from any country or
organization. Flag Tone is an independent game and is **not affiliated with or endorsed by** any
government, sports body, or standards agency.

Displays, browsers, and night mode can all shift how a color looks. Some places also have
**non-copyright rules** about how flags may be shown; that is separate from Flag Tone's game use. If
you need legally binding colors or usage guidance for print, uniforms, or public display, follow the
relevant authority in your jurisdiction.

## How to use Flag Tone

One Classic game is 5 rounds. Each round picks a distinct random flag and target band—no repeats in
the same game; match its true color with the sliders while the flag preview updates—no hex cheats.
1. 1**Study the flag** — the left panel shows which band to match; other regions stay at their true
   colors.
2. 2**Adjust H, S, and B** — the right preview updates live. Hue is color angle, saturation is
   intensity, brightness is how bright the color feels.
3. 3**Submit your guess** — you'll see how far off you were and your points for that round.
4. 4**Play all 5 rounds** — then review every target next to your pick on the results screen.
5. 5**Start over anytime** — use New game or Play again for a fresh set of distinct random flags and
   bands.

## Flag Tone FAQ

### In Flag Tone, what is ΔE (delta E), in simple terms?

In Flag Tone, after you submit, **ΔE is one number that says how different your color is from the
target**—like a distance score. **Lower is better**: small ΔE means the two colors are very similar;
big ΔE means they're far apart. You don't need Flag Tone's scale memorized—just know Flag Tone uses
it to measure "how far off" you were.

Technical note: Flag Tone converts both colors into a standard color space (CIELAB) that lines up
better with human vision than raw screen pixels, then takes the straight-line distance between them.
In Flag Tone, that distance is what we call ΔE here.

### In Flag Tone, what are pts (points)?

In Flag Tone, **pts are your Flag Tone game score in plain numbers.** Each turn in Flag Tone, you
can earn up to **100 pts** depending on how close you got. The Flag Tone number at the top is your
**running total** across turns you've already finished. When Flag Tone's all 5 turns are done, the
best possible total is **500 pts** (100 × 5).

### In Flag Tone, how is one turn's score (pts) calculated?

In Flag Tone, when you press **Submit guess**, Flag Tone compares your color to the target, gets one
ΔE for that turn, then turns ΔE into pts using this Flag Tone rule:

pts for this turn = round( max(0, 100 − 2 × ΔE) )

In words for Flag Tone: **the farther off you are (bigger ΔE), the fewer pts**; a near-perfect Flag
Tone match (ΔE near 0) is close to **100 pts**. Flag Tone scores cannot go below **0**.

Flag Tone examples: ΔE ≈ 0 → about **100 pts**; ΔE = **10** → **80 pts**; ΔE = **25** → **50 pts**.

### Why does Flag Tone use sliders (HSB) instead of typing a hex code?

Flag Tone wants you to **look** at color and nudge it like you would in a design app—warmer, cooler,
stronger, softer, darker, lighter. Hex codes stay in the background so the challenge stays visual.

### What happens if you stare at the flag long enough?

Nothing—unless you mean **press** long enough. During a round, hold your pointer on the flag preview
for **five full seconds** without letting up. The true colors appear; release and Flag Tone hides
them again. We keep that one out of the main board on purpose—spoilers travel faster down here in
the FAQ.

### Are Flag Tone's flag colors official government specifications?

**No.** In Flag Tone, flag geometry and colors are **reference illustrations for the game**—not
certified official specs, Pantone drop-ins, or manufacturing standards from any country or
organization. Flag Tone is an independent game and is **not affiliated with or endorsed by** any
government, sports body, or standards agency.

Displays, browsers, and night mode can all shift how a color looks. Some places also have
**non-copyright rules** about how flags may be shown; that is separate from Flag Tone's game use. If
you need legally binding colors or usage guidance for print, uniforms, or public display, follow the
relevant authority in your jurisdiction.

## What are HTML color codes?

Color codes are ways of representing the colors we see everyday in a format that a computer can
interpret and display. Commonly used in websites and other software applications, there are a
variety of formats, including Hex color codes, RGB and HSL values, and HTML color names, amongst
others.

### Hex color codes

The most popular are Hex color codes; three byte hexadecimal numbers (meaning they consist of six
digits), with each byte, or pair of characters in the Hex code, representing the intensity of red,
green and blue in the color respectively.

Hex code byte values range from 00, which is the lowest intensity of a color, to FF which represents
the highest intensity. The color white, for example, is made by mixing each of the three primary
colors at their full intensity, resulting in the Hex color code of #FFFFFF.

Black, the absence of any color on a screen display, is the complete opposite, with each color
displayed at their lowest possible intensity and a Hex color code of #000000.

green and blue in the color respectively.

the highest intensity. The color white, for example, is made by mixing each of the three primary
colors at their full intensity, resulting in the Hex color code of #FFFFFF.

Black, the absence of any color on a screen display, is the complete opposite, with each color

### About ICT International

ICT International design and develop science-led instrument solutions. For over 40 years, ICT
International has been applying scientific first principles to the development of innovative
measurement instruments and solutions for soil, plant, and environmental parameters.

Together, we are empowering global action to build a sustainable future.

[ Read more about ICT International here ][114]
[Photograph of the ICT International Mann Street Armidale building]

### [Services][115]

[ [Rain Gauge with Weather Station and IoT Node] ][116]

#### [Design, installation, and maintenance of measurement solutions][117]

For over 40 years, ICT International has been supporting the measurement of soil, plant, and
environmental parameters through providing advice, guidance, and support in the identification of
the appropriate methods, measurements, and instruments. ICT International provides services
including:
* Designing sensing solutions
* Installation of sensing solutions
* Scientific support services
* Sensing network upgrades
* Sensor calibration
* Sensor exchange and upgrade service
* Service and maintenance agreements
* Training and workshop sessions

## About Linshang

[Linshang Technology]

Shenzhen Linshang Technology Co., Ltd.  is a leading manufacturer of measuring instruments.
Established on June 16, 2008, LInshang boasts its independent and strong design, research and
development, production and sales of a wide range of measuring instruments. Our own trademark
"Linshang" was registered in 2010. At present, the company's self-developed products have obtained
more than 110 national patents and industry standard certification.

Linshang specializes in five main categories: solar film measurement, optical transmittance,
ultraviolet measurement,  gloss  and coating thickness measurement, hardness and thickness
measurement. Our products consists of Solar Film Transmission Meter, Spectrum Transmission Meter,
Light Transmittance Meter, UV Energy Meter, UV Light Meter, Glass Thickness Meter, Gloss meter,
Coating thickness gauge, Ultrasonic thickness gauge, Vacuum coating online thickness monitor,
Colorimeter, Hardness tester, Water quality tester, Illuminance meter, etc.

## About Linshang

[Linshang Technology]

Shenzhen Linshang Technology Co., Ltd.  is a leading manufacturer of measuring instruments.
Established on June 16, 2008, LInshang boasts its independent and strong design, research and
development, production and sales of a wide range of measuring instruments. Our own trademark
"Linshang" was registered in 2010. At present, the company's self-developed products have obtained
more than 110 national patents and industry standard certification.

Linshang specializes in five main categories: solar film measurement, optical transmittance,
ultraviolet measurement,  gloss  and coating thickness measurement, hardness and thickness
measurement. Our products consists of Solar Film Transmission Meter, Spectrum Transmission Meter,
Light Transmittance Meter, UV Energy Meter, UV Light Meter, Glass Thickness Meter, Gloss meter,
Coating thickness gauge, Ultrasonic thickness gauge, Vacuum coating online thickness monitor,
Colorimeter, Hardness tester, Water quality tester, Illuminance meter, etc.

### How does color analysis help me?

Color analysis helps you discover the colors that naturally enhance your features. When you wear
colors that harmonize with your skin tone, hair, and eyes, you look more vibrant and feel more
confident. It eliminates the guesswork from shopping and helps you build a wardrobe that makes you
look consistently great. Whether for clothing, makeup, or accessories, knowing your best colors is
the key to highlighting your natural beauty.

### How accurate is the AI color analysis?

Our AI color analysis is highly accurate when used correctly. For best results, use a clear,
well-lit selfie taken in natural daylight without filters. The AI analyzes multiple factors
including your skin undertone, contrast levels, and overall harmony to determine your best colors.
Our technology has been trained on thousands of professional color analyses and is continuously
refined for accuracy.

### What do I get with my color analysis?

Your analysis includes your seasonal color type, 120 personalized clothing colors, 170 makeup
shades, and 180 hair colors. You'll receive specific recommendations for clothing, accessories, and
makeup, plus digital color draping to visualize how different colors look on you. All results are
instantly available and can be accessed anytime through your account.

### Why am I getting different results sometimes?

If you're getting varying results, it usually means your coloring falls between two seasonal types.
This is completely normal! Some people have characteristics of multiple seasons. For the most
accurate results, take multiple photos in natural lighting and use the one that best represents your
natural coloring. If you're still unsure, our professional color consultants are available to help.

### Can I customize my color palette?

Yes! Unlike traditional printed color swatches, our digital palettes are fully customizable. You can
add specific colors you love, create custom combinations for your capsule wardrobe, and even
generate palettes from photos of your existing clothes. Premium users can save multiple custom
palettes and access them through our mobile app.

and time-consuming. Our AI-powered analysis provides instant results using advanced algorithms that

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Here are some of the most frequently asked questions about My Color Analysis AI. For any other
### questions, please contact us at [hello@mycoloranalysis.ai][17].

### How does color analysis help me?

Color analysis helps you discover the colors that naturally enhance your features. When you wear
colors that harmonize with your skin tone, hair, and eyes, you look more vibrant and feel more
confident. It eliminates the guesswork from shopping and helps you build a wardrobe that makes you
look consistently great. Whether for clothing, makeup, or accessories, knowing your best colors is
the key to highlighting your natural beauty.

### How accurate is the AI color analysis?

Our AI color analysis is highly accurate when used correctly. For best results, use a clear,
well-lit selfie taken in natural daylight without filters. The AI analyzes multiple factors
including your skin undertone, contrast levels, and overall harmony to determine your best colors.
Our technology has been trained on thousands of professional color analyses and is continuously
refined for accuracy.

### What do I get with my color analysis?

Your analysis includes your seasonal color type, 120 personalized clothing colors, 170 makeup
shades, and 180 hair colors. You'll receive specific recommendations for clothing, accessories, and
makeup, plus digital color draping to visualize how different colors look on you. All results are
instantly available and can be accessed anytime through your account.

### Why am I getting different results sometimes?

If you're getting varying results, it usually means your coloring falls between two seasonal types.
This is completely normal! Some people have characteristics of multiple seasons. For the most
accurate results, take multiple photos in natural lighting and use the one that best represents your
natural coloring. If you're still unsure, our professional color consultants are available to help.

### Can I customize my color palette?

Yes! Unlike traditional printed color swatches, our digital palettes are fully customizable. You can
add specific colors you love, create custom combinations for your capsule wardrobe, and even
generate palettes from photos of your existing clothes. Premium users can save multiple custom
palettes and access them through our mobile app.

### How is this different from traditional color analysis?

Traditional color analysis requires in-person draping with fabric swatches, which can be expensive
and time-consuming. Our AI-powered analysis provides instant results using advanced algorithms that
analyze your natural coloring. We offer digital draping to visualize colors on you, plus
comprehensive makeup and hair color recommendations - all access

quality, strength, durability, and safety of products under controlled conditions. At Presto, our

environmental test chambers, PET & preform, and colour measurement applications — helping industries
achieve zero rejection.
Who is the best laboratory equipment manufacturer in India?

### Q. What is lab testing equipment? **

manufacturing; industries such as

2. Plastic and Polymer
3. PET and Preform

HOW IT WORKS

## A color memory game *with no shortcuts.*

In this cartoon color guessing game, one color is missing from a cartoon scene — Patrick Star's
shorts, Bart Simpson's shirt, Kenny McCormick's parka — and you slide your way back to the exact hue
from memory.
1. ### One color goes missing.
   
   Every round whitens one body part or accessory on a familiar cartoon character. The pool
   refreshes weekly — memory isn't the only thing being tested over time.
2. ### Use the HSB sliders.
   
   The HSB sliders — Hue, Saturation, Brightness — set what you remember the color being. No second
   tries within a round, so first impression matters.
3. ### Score against the source.
   
   Your pick is compared to the official cartoon color in sRGB. 10 is a perfect tone match, 0 is
   pure white. Five rounds per Toon Tone game, averaged, plus a daily leaderboard.

FAQ

## Toon Tone FAQ

What is Toon Tone?

Toon Tone is a free browser color guessing game. Each round asks you to remember a cartoon character
color and rebuild it with hue, saturation, and brightness controls.

How do you play Toon Tone?

Study the target character part, adjust the HSB sliders until your guess matches the remembered
color, then submit to see your score and the original color.

Is ToonTone the same as Toon Tone?

Yes. ToonTone is the no-space spelling of Toon Tone. The official cartoon color guessing game is at
[toontone.app][48].

Is Toon Tone free?

Yes. Toon Tone runs in the browser and does not require a download, account, or payment.

How is this Toon Tone different from others?

This is the Toon Tone built and maintained by Sam at [toontone.app][49], with weekly character
drops, multilingual play (English, Russian, German, Spanish, Portuguese), and a public leaderboard.
Other Toon Tone sites exist online with their own focus.

What does the Toon Tone score measure?

Each round is scored from 0.00 to 10.00. The closer your color looks to the real hidden color, the
closer you get to 10.00. If you use a hint, that round loses 1 point, so even a great hinted guess
has a lower ceiling.

How is my final score calculated?

A full game has five rounds. Your five round scores are added together and divided by five. A 9.00
average means you were very close across the whole run, not just lucky once.

How does my message get on the wall?

After your final score, tap Post to wall. Your name is optional, and the message is already filled
in for you. The wall banner draws from posts in the last 3 days, using a 70/30 mix: about 70% recent
high-score posts and about 30% newest posts. Any posted score of 8.00+ counts as high score and
shows the TOP SCORER label; regular recent posts show NEW POST.

Does the game work on mobile?

Yes. It is built as a responsive web game and can be played on phones, tablets, laptops, and desktop
browsers.

Is the game affiliated with any cartoon studio?

No. This is an independent fan-made color memory game and is not affiliated with any cartoon studio,
network, or rights holder.

Are Toon Tone Game, Toone Tone, or Toon Toon Game the same game?

HOW IT WORKS

## A color memory game *with no shortcuts.*

In this cartoon color guessing game, one color is missing from a cartoon scene — Patrick Star's
shorts, Bart Simpson's shirt, Kenny McCormick's parka — and you slide your way back to the exact hue
from memory.
1. ### One color goes missing.
   
   Every round whitens one body part or accessory on a familiar cartoon character. The pool
   refreshes weekly — memory isn't the only thing being tested over time.
2. ### Use the HSB sliders.
   
   The HSB sliders — Hue, Saturation, Brightness — set what you remember the color being. No second
   tries within a round, so first impression matters.
3. ### Score against the source.
   
   Your pick is compared to the official cartoon color in sRGB. 10 is a perfect tone match, 0 is
   pure white. Five rounds per Toon Tone game, averaged, plus a daily leaderboard.

FAQ

## Toon Tone FAQ

What is Toon Tone?

Toon Tone is a free browser color guessing game. Each round asks you to remember a cartoon character
color and rebuild it with hue, saturation, and brightness controls.

How do you play Toon Tone?

Study the target character part, adjust the HSB sliders until your guess matches the remembered
color, then submit to see your score and the original color.

Is ToonTone the same as Toon Tone?

Yes. ToonTone is the no-space spelling of Toon Tone. The official cartoon color guessing game is at
[toontone.app][48].

Is Toon Tone free?

Yes. Toon Tone runs in the browser and does not require a download, account, or payment.

How is this Toon Tone different from others?

This is the Toon Tone built and maintained by Sam at [toontone.app][49], with weekly character
drops, multilingual play (English, Russian, German, Spanish, Portuguese), and a public leaderboard.
Other Toon Tone sites exist online with their own focus.

What does the Toon Tone score measure?

Each round is scored from 0.00 to 10.00. The closer your color looks to the real hidden color, the
closer you get to 10.00. If you use a hint, that round loses 1 point, so even a great hinted guess
has a lower ceiling.

How is my final score calculated?

A full game has five rounds. Your five round scores are added together and divided by five. A 9.00
average means you were very close across the whole run, not just lucky once.

How does my message get on the wall?

After your final score, tap Post to wall. Your name is optional, and the message is already filled
in for you. The wall banner draws from posts in the last 3 days, using a 70/30 mix: about 70% recent
high-score posts and about 30% newest posts. Any posted score of 8.00+ counts as high score and
shows the TOP SCORER label; regular recent posts show NEW POST.

Does the game work on mobile?

Yes. It is built as a responsive web game and can be played on phones, tablets, laptops, and desktop
browsers.

Is the game affiliated with any cartoon studio?

No. This is an independent fan-made color memory game and is not affiliated with any cartoon studio,
network, or rights holder.

Are Toon Tone Game, Toone Tone, or Toon Toon Game the same game?

# Every Digital Experience. Accessible to Every Person. Everywhere.

Vispero’s assistive technology and digital accessibility expertise open doors to independence and
inclusion for all.

## Digital accessibility is essential for everyone

### Vispero combines assistive technology and digital accessibility expertise to make inclusion
### achievable.

More than one billion people worldwide experience some form of disability, yet too many digital
experiences still leave them behind. Inaccessible design limits independence, participation, and
inclusion, and increases risk for organizations that fail to meet global accessibility standards.

Vispero helps close this gap by ensuring every user and every business can participate fully in the
digital world.

## How does Vispero create a unified digital accessibility ecosystem?

Vispero brings together the world’s most trusted assistive technology, including JAWS®, ZoomText,
and Fusion, with expert digital accessibility services that help organizations embrace digital
accessibility as a lasting capability, not a one-time project.

Whether you’re an individual looking to stay independent or an enterprise striving for compliance,
our solutions make accessibility achievable for all.

For more than 30 years, Vispero has set the global standard for accessibility innovation. We created
JAWS, the world’s most widely used screen reader, and continue to advance assistive technology and
digital accessibility for millions of users.

From individuals and educators to enterprises and government agencies, our technology transforms
accessibility from a requirement into a competitive advantage.
